inventory_metadata.audit_scope: Complete PDF report generation system - Arabic RTL support, fonts, charts, design system

1_stack_overview.report_pipeline_type: QuestPDF (native .NET PDF library with Fluent API) + SkiaSharp vector graphics
1_stack_overview.templating: QuestPDF Fluent API (Code-as-markup, no HTML/Handlebars templates)
1_stack_overview.charts_lib: SkiaSharp (native canvas rendering) for all charts - Radar/Heptagon, Bar, Donut, Gauge

styles.type: Centralized C# constants and helper methods

fonts_used.notes: Fonts copied to output directory via <CopyToOutputDirectory>Always</CopyToOutputDirectory> in .csproj

fonts_used.notes: System font used in chart labels when no Arabic present

Task<byte[]> RenderSdjResultPdfAsync(Result result, User user, CancellationToken ct = default)

active_implementation.notes: Legacy multi-dimension service - coexists with ModernSdjSevenPatternReportService

modern_sdj_implementation.entry_method: RenderSdjSevenPatternPdfAsync(Result result, User user, SdjScoreSummary sdjData, CancellationToken ct)
page_structure: Page 1: Cover + Participant Info + Professional Intro
Page 2: Visual Analytics (Sub-dimensions bar chart + 7-pattern heptagon radar)
modern_sdj_implementation.notes: This is the main SDJ 7-pattern report service - Arabic-first design

steps: 2. Fetch Result + Session + User from database (EF Core)
3. Detect SDJ vs Legacy via DimensionScoresJson structure
4. If SDJ: Parse SdjScoreSummary from JSON
a. Load fonts (QuestPDF FontManager + HarfBuzz typeface)
b. Load STEST.png logo from Resources/Brand/
c. Set Culture to ar-JO, QuestPDF License = Community

design_tokens.typography: ReportTheme.ArabicTextStyle(size, bold, color) → QuestPDF TextStyle with RTL

images_and_logos.logo_loading: LoadLogo() reads bytes into static _logoBytes field, embedded via .Image(_logoBytes)

icons_and_symbols.implementation: Unicode text symbols (✓, ⚠, ●) rendered as text with ArabicTextStyle
icons_and_symbols.notes: No separate icon files - all inline Unicode

text_rendering_engine.chart_text: SkiaSharp canvas + HarfBuzz shaping via SKShaper

test_arabic_rendering.actual_test_location: Likely tested manually - no automated visual regression tests found

current_warnings: No automated visual regression tests for Arabic text rendering
Manual verification required for each deployment
Potential line-breaking issues with very long Arabic text (not documented)

rtl_chart_axes.notes: SkiaSharp canvas rendering places labels manually - no native RTL support in charts. HeptagonRadarChartRenderer positions Arabic labels radially with proper HarfBuzz shaping.

font_consistency.issue: Chart labels use SkiaSharp typeface, PDF text uses QuestPDF fonts
font_consistency.mitigation: Both load Noto Naskh Arabic, but different rendering paths

chart_size_and_resolution.image_format: PNG encoded at 100% quality, embedded as base64 in PDF

encoding_issues.details: UTF-8 enforced throughout. System.Text.Encoding.CodePages package registered for legacy encodings if needed.

table_and_layout.rtl_tables: Implemented via QuestPDF Table with AlignRight()

logging_and_debugging.warnings_in_logs: Console.WriteLine statements throughout report services for debugging
logging_and_debugging.no_silent_failures: Exceptions propagate to controller and return 500 with error message
logging_and_debugging.notes: Production logs should be monitored for font registration failures

fonts.notes: Must be TrueType (.ttf) or OpenType (.otf) with Arabic Unicode range U+0600-U+06FF

headers_and_footers.notes: Modify text content and styling in this method

generation_time.measured_example: Not explicitly logged in codebase - requires profiling

factors: PNG chart images (~20-50 KB each x 4-5 charts)

memory_leaks.font_caching: Fonts loaded once per service lifetime via static _fontsRegistered flag
memory_leaks.skia_resources: using statements on SKCanvas, SKBitmap, SKTypeface, SKFont, SKPaint
memory_leaks.status: APPEARS SAFE - proper disposal patterns followed

caching.font_cache: Fonts registered once globally per app instance
caching.notes: Consider Redis cache for generated PDF bytes keyed by result.Id + version

security_considerations.authorization: No per-user authorization checks - any authenticated user can access any result PDF
security_considerations.injection_risks: None - no SQL/HTML injection possible (parameterized queries, no HTML rendering)
security_considerations.file_path_traversal: Fonts loaded from fixed paths (AppContext.BaseDirectory + relative path)
security_considerations.status: ⚠ AUTHORIZATION GAP - users can access other users' PDFs by guessing result IDs

scalability.concurrent_generation: Thread-safe (lock on font registration, stateless service after init)
scalability.horizontal_scaling: Supported - each instance registers fonts independently
scalability.database_bottleneck: EF Core query fetches result + session + user + dimension scores - indexed on result.Id
scalability.notes: Consider background job queue (Hangfire/Quartz) for bulk report generation

automated_tests.notes: ⚠ HIGH RISK - no automated tests for PDF generation or Arabic rendering

dependencies_to_verify: QuestPDF v2024.7.0 (check for updates - newer versions may have better Arabic support)
linux_deployment_checklist: 1. Ensure libSkiaSharp.so and libHarfBuzzSharp.so are in output directory
2. Install libfontconfig1 on host (apt-get install libfontconfig1)
3. Verify Resources/Fonts/ directory copied to output
4. Test PDF generation in container before going live (docker exec -it ... curl http://localhost:5019/api/results/1/pdf)

environment_variables.USE_SDJ: Set to '1' to enable SDJ scoring and 7-pattern reports (default: legacy mode)
